required.quote: The superintendent shall require as a condition to continuation of an insurance producer license that during the twenty-four months next preceding expiration of the current license period the licensee has attended the minimum number of hours of formal class instruction, lectures or seminars required and approved by the superintendent

available.quote: An individual who applies for an insurance producer license in this state who was previously licensed for the same lines of authority in another state shall not be required to take an examination.

requirements.value: Applicant must be currently licensed in the other state or apply within ninety days of cancellation of prior license and have been in good standing. A person moving to NM from another state must apply within ninety days of establishing legal residence.
requirements.quote: This exemption is only available if the person is currently licensed in that state or if the application is received within ninety days of the cancellation of the applicant's previous license and if the prior state issues a certification that, at the time of cancellation, the applicant was in good standing in that state or the state's insurance producer database records, maintained by the national association of insurance commissioners, its affiliates or subsidiaries, indicate that the insurance producer is or was licensed in good standing for the line of authority requested.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Insurer or insurance producer fails to report termination of a producer's appointment as required.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: An insurer, the authorized representative of the insurer or insurance producer that fails to report as required under the provisions of this section or that is found by a court of competent jurisdiction to have reported with actual malice may, after notice and hearing, have its license or certificate of authority suspended or revoked and may be fined in accordance with the Insurance Code.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Termination of a producer for insolvency, abandonment, gross or willful misconduct, failure to pay money due, fraud, or intentional misrepresentation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The provisions of Subsection A or B of this section shall not apply to termination of a contract for insolvency, abandonment, gross or willful misconduct, failure to pay over to the company money due to the company under existing agency or company contract after receipt of a written demand therefor, fraud or intentional misrepresentation by the insurance producer

disciplinary_grounds.description: Offering, giving, or selling stock or ownership interest as inducement to purchase insurance.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The superintendent shall not license as an insurance producer, or permit any such license to continue, if the superintendent finds that the licensee did, or that the applicant for license intends to offer, give or sell stock or other ownership or participating interest in the agency or brokerage as inducement to or in connection with purchase of insurance.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Paying or accepting a commission for selling, soliciting, or negotiating insurance to or from an unlicensed person.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: An insurance company or insurance producer shall not pay a commission, service fee, brokerage or other valuable consideration to a person for selling, soliciting or negotiating insurance in this state if that person is required to be licensed under Chapter 59A, Article 12 NMSA 1978 and is not so licensed.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to disclose and obtain documented acknowledgment of compensation received from insurers when also receiving compensation from the customer.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: neither that insurance producer nor the affiliate shall accept or receive any compensation from an insurer or other third party for that placement of insurance unless the insurance producer has, prior to the customer's purchase of insurance: (1) obtained the customer's documented acknowledgment that such compensation will be received by the insurance producer or affiliate

disciplinary_grounds.description: Diverting or appropriating funds held in a fiduciary capacity to the producer's own use or taking with intent to embezzle.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any person who diverts or appropriates funds to the person's own use, or takes or secretes with intent to embezzle, all without consent of the person entitled to the funds, is guilty of larceny by embezzlement.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in activities requiring a license without holding the required license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A person shall not sell, solicit or negotiate insurance in this state for any class or classes of insurance unless the person is licensed for that line of insurance in accordance with the Insurance Code.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conducting business under any name other than the producer's legal name without prior written approval of the superintendent.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: An insurance producer shall not do business under any name other than the insurance producer's legal name without prior written approval of the superintendent.

lines_of_authority.quote: An insurance producer may receive qualification for a license in one or more of the following lines of authority: (1) life insurance coverage on human lives...(2) accident and health or sickness insurance...(3) property insurance...(4) casualty insurance...(5) variable life and variable annuity products...(6) personal lines property and casualty insurance...(7) limited line credit insurance; and (8) any other line of insurance permitted under state laws.

nonresident_license_available.quote: The superintendent may refuse to issue a license as an insurance producer to a resident of another state or country, who is otherwise qualified under Chapter 59A, Article 12 NMSA 1978 for license as an insurance producer in New Mexico

business_entity_license_available.quote: A business entity acting as an insurance producer is required to obtain an insurance producer license.

designated_licensee_required_for_busines.quote: the business entity has designated a licensed insurance producer responsible for the business entity's compliance with the insurance laws of this state;

temporary_license_available.quote: The superintendent may issue a temporary insurance producer license for a period not to exceed one hundred eighty days without requiring an examination if the superintendent deems that the temporary license is necessary for the servicing of an insurance business

temporary_license_max_days.quote: The superintendent may issue a temporary insurance producer license for a period not to exceed one hundred eighty days

appointment_required_to_represent_insure.quote: An insurance producer shall not act as an agent of an insurer unless the insurance producer becomes an appointed insurance producer of that insurer.

appointment_fee.value: Filing appointment fee in the amount and method of payment set forth in Section 59A-6-1 NMSA 1978
appointment_fee.quote: An insurer shall pay a filing appointment fee in the amount and method of payment set forth in Section 59A-6-1 NMSA 1978 for each insurance producer appointed by the insurer.

appointment_termination_reporting_days.quote: An insurer or authorized representative of the insurer that terminates the appointment, employment contract or other insurance business relationship with an insurance producer shall notify the superintendent within thirty days following the effective date of the termination

written_consumer_representation_agreemen.quote: obtained the customer's documented acknowledgment that such compensation will be received by the insurance producer or affiliate

fiduciary_duty_for_funds.quote: All funds of others received by a person licensed or acting as an insurance producer...are received and held by the person in a fiduciary capacity.

naic_producer_database_used_for_verifica.quote: the state's insurance producer database records, maintained by the national association of insurance commissioners, its affiliates or subsidiaries, indicate that the insurance producer is or was licensed in good standing for the line of authority requested.

home_state_change_application_window_day.quote: A person licensed as an insurance producer in another state who moves to this state shall apply within ninety days of establishing legal residence to become a resident insurance producer.

lapsed_license_reinstatement_window_days.quote: An insurance producer who allows the insurance producer's license to lapse may, within twelve months from the due date of the renewal fee, reinstate the same license without the necessity of passing a written examination.
